_update: Edit this file when Next.js ships a security release (https://nextjs.org/blog, tag 'Security'; advisories at https://github.com/vercel/next.js/security/advisories). Set asOf to the day you checked, release/url to the newest security release, and each line's patched version. A major no longer listed under lines, or past its securityUntil, counts as unsupported. Majors newer than every line get no warning. See internal/mod/runtime/nextsecurity.go.
_proxyFraming: Next.js versions that can forward a fetched Response with the compressed response's framing (GHSA-pc58-hwjq-p385). The switchboard gives their instances a fresh connection per request, so stray bytes never reach another client's response. A major below every entry counts as affected, one above them all as fixed. Change only if Next.js reopens this advisory.
